title: Heterogeneous Policy Effects in Comparative Case Studies with Treated-Unit Microdata
abstract: arXiv:2609.28678v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy reforms are sometimes accompanied by detailed individual-level data in the implementing jurisdiction, while only aggregate outcomes are available for potential comparison jurisdictions. This article develops an identification framework for heterogeneous policy effects when individual-level data are unavailable for the comparison units. The framework combines treatment-effect contrasts from difference-in-differences comparisons within the treated jurisdiction with a compatible population-average effect identified from aggregate panel data. Identification requires relative parallel trends within the treated jurisdiction together with the assumptions needed to identify the population-average effect from the aggregate panel. The within-jurisdiction component can be estimated from repeated cross-sections with a single pretreatment period.

translated_title: 基于处理单元微观数据的比较案例研究中的异质性政策效应
translated_abstract: 政策改革有时会伴随实施辖区内详细的个体层面数据，而潜在的对比辖区仅有总体结果数据可用。本文开发了一个在对比单元无法获得个体层面数据时识别异质性政策效应的框架。该框架将处理辖区内通过双重差分比较得到的处理效应对比，与从总体面板数据中识别出的相容的人口平均效应相结合。识别需要处理辖区内的相对平行趋势假设，以及从总体面板中识别人口平均效应所需的假设。辖区内的组成部分可以通过仅包含单一处理前时期的重复横截面数据进行估计。
tldr: 本文提出了一种识别框架，在只有处理单元拥有个体微观数据而对比单元仅有总体数据的情况下，通过结合辖区内双重差分估计与从总体面板数据识别的人口平均效应，实现异质性政策效应的识别。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an identification framework for heterogeneous policy effects when microdata exist only for the treated unit, combining within-jurisdiction difference-in-differences contrasts with a compatible population-average effect identified from aggregate panel data.
